subject: Next steps: procurement & marketplace path for Redwood
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@omnidata.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@omnidata.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: procurement & marketplace path for Redwood

Sam / Priya — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's call: 

- Procurement posture: you mentioned legal/proc are comfortable with a standard SaaS MSA but need to confirm PO vs card for payment.
- Marketplace interest: OmniData is interested in AWS Marketplace private offers for procurement simplicity (you flagged that as preferred). You asked whether Redwood supports AWS Marketplace, GCP, and Azure.
- Security & compliance: you'll need SOC 2 report and answers to a short security questionnaire (we can provide both).

Action items / next steps: 
1) Can you confirm whether OmniData will prefer a PO (net 30) or corporate card for the initial pilot? If PO, please share your PO template.
2) Are you looking to transact via AWS Marketplace Private Offer or directly (card/PO) for the pilot? If Marketplace, we will need to scope the pricing flow and timeline.
3) I'll share the standard Redwood terms, SOC 2 report, and the security questionnaire by EOD.

I've attached our standard SaaS terms for procurement review. If it helps, happy to do a short meeting with your procurement contact next week to walk through the marketplace options.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_Terms_SaaS_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sam Patel <sam@omnidata.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@omnidata.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 18:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement & marketplace path for Redwood

Thanks Camila — appreciate the recap. A few quick notes: 

- Payment: OmniData prefers to use a PO (net 30) for new vendor pilots. We typically issue a PO once legal signs the MSA. I've attached our PO template for your contracts team to review.
- Marketplace: We strongly prefer AWS Marketplace private offers because it fits our internal billing and approval flow. If Redwood can do an AWS private offer that would be ideal. GCP/Azure are lower priority for now.
- Security: Please send SOC 2 type II and the questionnaire. We'll run it through InfoSec. Timeline wise, procurement + legal internal approval is usually ~3 weeks for pilots after we have final terms.

Next step: please send editable MSA with our PO template marked up, and let's schedule a 30-min sync with procurement next Tues (Mar 14) at 10am PT — I'll confirm with our procurement lead.

Best,
Sam
VP Product, OmniData
sam@omnidata.ai

Thanks Sam — that's helpful. A few clarifications and commitments from our side: 

- AWS Marketplace: Redwood supports AWS Marketplace private offers. We can set up a private offer for OmniData which preserves your billing flow (PO via your AWS account). For initial pilots we can also accept direct PO invoicing off our standard MSA if you prefer to avoid marketplace listing setup time — whichever speeds your internal approval.
- PO template: Thanks for sending — I'll have our contracts manager review and send back an editable MSA with comments by EOD Monday.
- Security docs: attaching SOC 2 type II and a short security questionnaire (answers inline). If InfoSec needs more detail we'll route to our security team.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I'll circulate the marked-up MSA (Camila / Marissa).
2) If you confirm marketplace (AWS) preference, we'll kick off the AWS private offer workflow (Jonas will coordinate the listing and pricing paperwork).
3) Schedule the procurement sync — Mar 14 10am PT works for us; please send invite with any procurement attendees.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 | DocuSign prep: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef-omnidata

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Internal — quick note following Camila's thread with OmniData: 

- Pricing: Sam indicated pilot via AWS private offer or standard PO. Camila, please confirm whether we should quote (a) AWS Marketplace private offer pricing or (b) direct PO invoice pricing for pilot. If private offer, we'll need the list price + marketplace commission considerations; Jonas, can you prepare a draft private-offer pricing worksheet?
- Contracts: I'll review OmniData's PO template and incorporate necessary MSA changes; aim to send marked MSA back by EOD Mon (Camila assigned).
- Security: SOC2 doc looks good; if InfoSec requests additional evidence we'll loop security@redwood.ai.

Assigning: Camila — send MSA draft to Sam & Priya; Jonas — start AWS private offer checklist if OmniData confirms.

Thx,
Marissa
